scripts.dev: bun run esbuild && cargo build --workspace --features verbose-logs && bun postbuild.js debug && cargo run --features editor-ignore,verbose-logs
scripts.build: bun run esbuild && cargo build --workspace --release --features packaged,editor-ignore --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc && bun postbuild.js x86_64-pc-windows-msvc/release
scripts.build:auto-update: bun run esbuild && cargo build --workspace --release --features packaged,auto-update,editor-ignore --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc && bun postbuild.js x86_64-pc-windows-msvc/release
scripts.package: bun run build:auto-update && wix build ./resources/installer_script.wxs -ext WixToolset.Util.wixext -o target/kute-setup-x86_64.msi
